system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: hashes of the assembled system prompt and optional instructions; the sorted tool names and hashes of their descriptions and input schemas
system_prompt_style.note: Manifest records assembled system prompt plus agent profile/mode and tool selection; per-request composition.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: calls tools (shell, editor, LSP, MCP servers, scientific connectors, and skills), and streams its work back to the browser

observation_format.evidence_quote: a terminal, session history, and inline rendering for molecules, structures, genomes, and plots
observation_format.note: Inline rendering is a browser UI feature; only text tool output evidenced as model-facing.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: the sorted tool names and hashes of their descriptions and input schemas
tool_call_format.note: Tool contracts with input schemas imply provider tool-calling; parser not shown in evidence.

tool_count.note: Counts given for connectors (42) and capabilities (54) but not the default model-facing tool list.

edit_primitive.note: An 'editor' tool is mentioned but its edit commands are not shown.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: LSP integration, MCP servers, plugins, custom agents and commands, and a TypeScript SDK.
tool_schema_source.note: MCP schemas fetched from servers; first-party schema source not directly evidenced.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Five reviewed connector presets help configure common MCP endpoints, but they save disabled for inspection

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The agent plans with a research harness, calls tools (shell, editor, LSP, MCP servers, scientific connectors, and skills)
loop_primitives.note: plan mode is a shipped read-only mode.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Multi-stage research can define a durable completion contract
planning_granularity.note: Durable contract with gates/trials is a stored structured plan-like object; plan mode also exists.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: A single user-facing collaborator handles the task end to end, loads domain skills when useful, and delegates independent Explore or Execute work when it helps.
multi_agent_topology.note: Delegation default is 'Auto'; can be turned Off.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: delegates independent Explore or Execute work when it helps. Off, Auto, and High delegation guide how readily it parallelizes

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: New local installs start in **Approve for me**
human_in_loop.note: Switchable to Ask for approval or Full access; compute jobs require a one-run approval card.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: automatic contract continuation follows a fingerprint of gates, immutable ArtifactStore versions, jobs, and kernels

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Reusable project lessons become independently supported only from verified observations across more than one session
long_term_memory.note: 309 bundled skills loaded on demand; project lessons persist across sessions.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Sessions, settings, credentials, skills, artifacts, and provenance are stored on disk.
state_persistence.note: Session history and automatic contract continuation with checkpoints.

self_verification.evidence_quote: No capability is labeled verified until a release-artifact canary passes.
self_verification.note: Canaries/validation are harness-run checks on capabilities; completion 'never waits on a separate reviewer model or hidden review gate'.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: It continues while that evidence changes, attempts one focused repair when progress stalls, then preserves the agent's real response

termination_condition.evidence_quote: the complete session tree has configurable model-call, tool-call, token, wall-clock, and cost ceilings
termination_condition.note: Also wall-clock; stall triggers one repair then an explicit partial/blocked boundary.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Legacy 5M-token contracts migrate to the current 20M default only when persisted `research_contract` history proves `max_tokens` was omitted
cost_controls.note: Also cost ceilings; per-request model routing exists but is user-configured, not cost-based.

timeouts.evidence_quote: the complete session tree has configurable model-call, tool-call, token, wall-clock, and cost ceilings
timeouts.note: Per-job timeout for compute jobs; wall-clock ceiling per session tree.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: the project is trusted, while commands run inside macOS Seatbelt or Linux bubblewrap containment
execution_isolation.note: Local sandboxed subprocess by default; Modal remote sandboxes available for compute jobs.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: sandboxed scientific tools keep caches beneath the writable session workspace
filesystem_access.note: Seatbelt/bubblewrap containment scopes writes; Full access mode disables containment.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Keep the default `python:3.12-slim` image, blocked network, and a short timeout for the smoke test.
network_policy.note: Local sandbox network not restricted by evidence; Modal jobs have a configurable network policy, blocked for packaged capabilities.

permission_model.evidence_quote: The composer’s **Research tools → Action approval** menu can switch to **Ask for approval**
permission_model.note: Default 'Approve for me' auto-approves in a trusted project with containment; dispatches still need a bound approval card.

tracing.evidence_quote: OpenScience records the effective model-facing harness before every assistant inference attempt.
tracing.note: An `experimental.openTelemetry` flag exists but the roadmap audit says it emits no span.

replayability.evidence_quote: The session trace replays manifests, inference records, and tool calls into three checks
replayability.note: Deterministic trajectory fingerprint enables exact-match detection, but prompt content is not retained.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: They deliberately do not provide benchmark datasets, official graders, leaderboard claims, or a candidate optimizer
eval_hooks.note: `open-bench/` exists but roadmap audit says it is untracked by git with zero .py.

guardrails.evidence_quote: arbitrary Python/R kernels receive a minimal environment, and credential-shaped values are redacted from output
guardrails.note: Approval/permission gating and dispatch digests are action policies.

target_domain.evidence_quote: The open-source AI workbench for scientific research

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: It is model-agnostic, open source, and built to do real work in machine learning, biology, physics, and chemistry.
